description:
Upstream's `app.message.followUp` (Alt+Enter) queues the current input as a follow-up message (delivered when the agent finishes its current run) instead of blocking until idle.

Our Interactive doesn't handle Alt+Enter — it falls through to the Input component. The Session already supports `follow_up/2` but there's no UI path to it.

Implement: on Alt+Enter while agent is running, call `Agent.follow_up(session, text)`, clear the input, show a brief 'follow-up queued' notification. When idle, Alt+Enter should behave like regular Enter (submit immediately).

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L3285-3310.
title: Interactive: Alt+Enter follow-up message queuing
